# External data

Full game dumps are not included.

- `turnbasedgamedata/ExcelOutput/AvatarSkillConfig.json` is a **synthetic example**
  with Sparkle talent `1130604` L10 `ParamList` only (see `docs/shared_trigger_rules.md`).
- Use `scripts/fetch_datamine.py` for a Dimbreath TurnBasedGameData subset and
  `scripts/fetch_starrail_res.py` for [Mar-7th/StarRailRes](https://github.com/Mar-7th/StarRailRes).
